tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside an allowed read root.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search UTF-8 text files under an allowed read root, skipping symlinks and generated directories.

tools.name: terminal_create
tools.description: Create a persistent terminal (PTY) session through Skynet Workshop. Returns a session_id. Use terminal_write and terminal_output for interactive programs such as copilot or gh auth login; use terminal_exec for non-interactive commands. Requires write permission.

cwd.description: Working directory. Must be inside an allowed read root.

tools.name: terminal_destroy
tools.description: Destroy a terminal session and release its PTY. Requires write permission.

tools.name: terminal_exec
tools.description: Run a non-interactive shell command in an existing terminal session and return its bounded output and exit code. Create a session with terminal_create first. Use terminal_write and terminal_output for interactive programs such as copilot or gh auth login. Requires write permission.

command.description: Shell command to execute in the session.

tools.name: terminal_output
tools.description: Read bounded output from a terminal session. Use wait_ms to wait for a prompt or login code. Output is sanitized (ANSI escapes and control characters removed) and capped. Requires write permission.

offset.description: Byte offset into the session output. Defaults to the tail.

tools.name: terminal_write
tools.description: Type text into an existing terminal session. By default Enter is appended, so the text runs as a command. Set submit=false to type without pressing Enter, for example when an interactive prompt asks for a value. Requires write permission.

require_idle.description: Refuse to write while the session is busy. Default false.

text.description: Text to type into the session.

Use terminal_write and terminal_output for interactive programs such as copilot or gh auth login. Requires write permission.

command.description: Shell command to execute in the session.

tools.name: terminal_output
tools.description: Read bounded output from a terminal session. Use wait_ms to wait for a prompt or login code. Output is sanitized (ANSI escapes and control characters removed) and capped. Requires write permission.

offset.description: Byte offset into the session output. Defaults to the tail.

tools.name: terminal_write
tools.description: Type text into an existing terminal session. By default Enter is appended, so the text runs as a command. Set submit=false to type without pressing Enter, for example when an interactive prompt asks for a value. Requires write permission.

require_idle.description: Refuse to write while the session is busy. Default false.

text.description: Text to type into the session.
